scope: Two new boron mineral identities. Ginorite includes one bounded abiotic thermal response; sulfoborite is identity-only. No criticality, microbial extraction or industrial deployment claim. Independent scientific review is separate and pending.

selected.why: Official distinct species with complete natural characterization and primary instrumental thermal evidence.
Official distinct species with complete original crystal structure; later neutron evidence held pending full-text access.

identity.ginorite: IMA September2026 p83, G,1934: Ca2B14O20(OH)6(H2O)3·2H2O. Five waters total;1934 is not an approval accession. Distinct from strontioginorite.
identity.sulfoborite: IMA September2026 p208, G,1893: Mg3[B(OH)4]2(SO4)(OH,F)2. Variable species notation retained separately from the1983 ideal OHF structure. No approval accession invented.

decisions: Ginorite1957: accepted onset70-80C and troughs100/150/310/360/470C as reported instrumental features. Nominal30C/min through500C; -50+200mesh; medium sensitivity;10C readings; at least three runs. No products, gas identities, mass loss, equilibrium temperatures or recovery yields inferred.

Allen-Kramer1957 original and normalized chemistry are distinct. Warm-water washing/105C drying belongs to that characterization; the DTA aliquot preparation is not proven identical. Alumina mixtures and postheat XRD of other borates are not assigned to ginorite.

Perchiazzi2016 p84: specimen7678, preliminary Sr nondetection and restrained H refinement. Table2 reproduces historical chemistry. P21/a and the2018 P21/c setting are not evidence of a phase transition.

Pankova2018 p279:296(2)K in abstract/data row conflicts with293K in methods/table labels; only general structure context used. Table3 contains mean-distance inconsistencies; detailed distances, density and H geometry are not imported. Supplementary S1-S3 inaccessible in bounded search. The2018 assertion that ginorite structure had never been reported is not adopted, given the complete2016 primary.

Sulfoborite1983 p260 explicitly lacks chemical analysis for measured crystal. No percentages from another specimen are transferred. Historical restricted H bonding is not universalized. Separately deposited AM82-212 factors are unacquired.

Sulfoborite2026: Crossref/Edinburgh verify DOI10.2138/am-2025-10169 and early-online28April2026; public linked manuscript and publisher PDF both403. Abstract used only to flag later evidence, never quantitative curation. Bromiley publication page duplicates berborite DOIam-2025-10029 under sulfoborite; correct DOI follows Crossref and repository.
